cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll look after your dog while the kitchen's repaired. I'll make the arrangements; bring him after his walk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He'll need to stay overnight too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. You can have the guest room with him. Choose whichever bedding he likes; I'll leave breakfast ready for you both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stay, but the six o'clock walk is yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed, I'll organize it around you. You choose the route; I'll put the lead by your shoes and set your alarm. All you'll have to do is take him out.
